title: Temple building flourishes at Bagan
summary: Bagan’s landscape accumulated temples, stupas and monasteries during the eleventh to thirteenth centuries. Religious donations and royal patronage supported a major concentration of Buddhist architecture beside the Ayeyarwady River.
